# reliable.go roadmap

## Acks

Knowing which of the packets you sent were received by the other side.

<!-- nova-work:acks:start -->

| feature | done |
|---|:---:|
| acks for packets received | ✅ |
| acks stay correct under packet loss | ✅ |
| 32 acks redundantly in every packet header | ✅ |
| a full ack buffer drops extra acks and logs | ✅ |
| ask the sequence of the next packet, to map acks to contents | ✅ |
| the receiver can decline to ack a packet | ❌ |
| complete | 83% |

[Source data](docs/roadmap.sexp)

<!-- nova-work:acks:end -->

## Packets

Sending and receiving packets over your own UDP socket, including packets larger than the MTU.

<!-- nova-work:packets:start -->

| feature | done |
|---|:---:|
| send and receive packets | ✅ |
| fragmentation and reassembly of large packets | ✅ |
| incomplete fragmented packets are cleaned up | ✅ |
| fragment configurations that cannot fit a packet are refused | ✅ |
| duplicate packets detected and dropped | ✅ |
| stale packets dropped | ✅ |
| sequence numbers wrap around safely | ✅ |
| reset an endpoint to its initial state | ✅ |
| malformed packets refused, fuzzed | ✅ |
| complete | 100% |

[Source data](docs/roadmap.sexp)

<!-- nova-work:packets:end -->
